method: Parse root workspace member Cargo.toml with Python tomllib. Count raw .rs source under each member/src, including inline test modules, comments and blanks. Separate integration tests under member/tests. Graph is declared normal internal edges, not a Cargo feature-resolved consumer closure; optional edges and all target tables retained. Mandatory closure traverses only nonoptional target-independent normal edges and ignores default features, so it is an incompleteness proof/lower bound, not a full resolved closure. No builds or cargo execution.
